title: The Shadow of the Wind
author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón
vibe: Rainy Barcelona libraries, secret books, lost authors
quote: Every book has a soul. The soul of the person who wrote it and of those who read it and lived and dreamed with it.
description: In post-war Barcelona, a young boy is taken to the secret Cemetery of Forgotten Books to choose a volume that will change his life forever.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
vibe: Candlelit ballrooms, witty letters, timeless romance
quote: I declare after all there is no enjoyment like reading! How much sooner one tires of any thing than of a book!
description: A dazzling comedy of manners, misunderstandings, and unforgettable romantic electricity in the English countryside.

title: The Night Circus
author: Erin Morgenstern
vibe: Black and white tents, clockwork dreams, midnight magic
quote: The circus arrives without warning. It is simply there, when yesterday it was not.
description: A fierce competition between two young illusionists who have been trained since childhood to compete in an ethereal nocturnal circus.

title: Meditations
author: Marcus Aurelius
vibe: Quiet stoic reflection, morning stillness, inner peace
quote: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
description: The private journal of a Roman Emperor meditating on duty, resilience, peace of mind, and the fleeting nature of life.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
vibe: Aesthetic London parlors, secret portraits, velvet curtains
quote: Behind every exquisite thing that existed, there was something tragic.
description: A wealthy young man trades his soul to remain eternally young while his portrait in the attic decays with his sins.

title: The Little Prince
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
vibe: Desert stars, single roses, quiet childlike wonder
quote: It is only with the heart that one can see rightly; what is essential is invisible to the eye.
description: A stranded pilot meets a gentle prince from a tiny asteroid who teaches him about love, friendship, and the meaning of innocence.
